---
title: "3-CO2xComm Derived Root Biomass 2000-2024"
output: html_document
date: "2025-03-03"
---

```{r}
# This program calculates the annual production of belowground biomass as measured by ingrowth Cores. They are from an experiment that begain in 1987 in which the air CO2 concentration  was increased in three plant communities. The program ingests data from the belowground production that was measured by implanting bags filled with commerical sedge peat into three  locations per Chamber each Year in November, and recovering them one Year later. Each bag is 26 cm2 and 40 cm deep. Sample processing has varied over the Years, with recoved belowground  biomass being separated into roots, C3 rhizomes, C4 rhizomes or just total mass, and combinations thereof.  Staring in 2016 a new category was added, "Other Rhizome Biomass" which is  rarely used. Because methods varied over the course of this long-term study, there is code that makes a variety of adjustments to the input data in order arrive at a comparable annual figure for each plot. Contact Pat Megonigal for details.

# Updated 03-03-2025 to only run current year data and append to previous years data

# 1978-2017 do not align with SAS output. 2018 to present does.

# install.packages("readr")
# install.packages("tidyverse")
library(readr)
library(tidyverse)
# These lines of code download any required packages for the code to function.

# set year & previous year
previous_year=2023
year=2024
# throughout this code, when importing .csv files you will need to manually add in the (published XX-XX-XXX) date as this changes each year.

# DO NOT MOVE PREVIOUS YEAR FILES TO 'RETIRED' FOLDER UNTIL THIS CODE HAS BEEN RUN

```

```{r}

# Importing the rootbiomass CSV file
rootbiomass_allyears <- read.csv(paste0('S:/Biogeochemistry/GCREW/1-CO2xCommunity Experiment/0-Curated Data/5-Root Ingrowth Data/CO2xComm Master Root Ingrowth 1987-',year,' (published 03-03-2025).csv'), header = TRUE, sep = ",")
# you will need to manually adjust the published date as this changes.

#Filter out current year
rootbiomass <- rootbiomass_allyears[rootbiomass_allyears$Year == year,]

# Clean and mutate the data
rootdata <- rootbiomass %>%
  mutate(
    RootMass = ifelse(RootMass == -99, NA, RootMass),
    C3RhizMass = ifelse(C3RhizMass == -99, NA, C3RhizMass),
    C4RhizMass = ifelse(C4RhizMass == -99, NA, C4RhizMass),
    OtherRhizMass = ifelse(OtherRhizMass == -99, 0, OtherRhizMass),
    TotalRhizMass = ifelse(TotalRhizMass == -99, NA, TotalRhizMass),
    RootRhizMass = ifelse(RootRhizMass == -99, NA, RootRhizMass),
    # Convert masses to m2
    RootMass_m2 = (RootMass / 25.5176) * 10000,
    C3RhizMass_m2 = (C3RhizMass / 25.5176) * 10000,
    C4RhizMass_m2 = (C4RhizMass / 25.5176) * 10000,
    OtherRhizMass_m2 = (OtherRhizMass / 25.5176) * 10000,
    RootRhizMass_m2 = (RootRhizMass / 25.5176) * 10000,
    # Sum of RhizMass
    RhizMass_m2 = C3RhizMass_m2 + C4RhizMass_m2 + OtherRhizMass_m2,
    # Convert TotalRhizMass to m2
    TotalRhizMass_m2 = (TotalRhizMass / 25.5176) * 10000,
    # Calculate total belowground mass
    TotalBelowMass_m2 = RootMass_m2 + RhizMass_m2
  ) %>%
  # Adjust TotalBelowMass_m2 based on Year conditions
  mutate(TotalBelowMass_m2 = case_when(
    Year == 1992 ~ RootRhizMass_m2,
    Year %in% c(1997, 1998) ~ RootMass_m2 + RhizMass_m2,
    TRUE ~ TotalBelowMass_m2
  ))
# Sort data by Year, Community, Treatment, Chamber, Core
rootdata <- rootdata %>%
  arrange(Year, Community, Treatment, Chamber, Core)
# Calculate means by Year, Community, Treatment, Chamber
root_means <- rootdata %>%
  group_by(Year, Community, Treatment, Chamber) %>%
  summarise(
    RootMass_m2 = mean(RootMass_m2, na.rm = TRUE),
    C3RhizMass_m2 = mean(C3RhizMass_m2, na.rm = TRUE),
    C4RhizMass_m2 = mean(C4RhizMass_m2, na.rm = TRUE),
    RhizMass_m2 = mean(RhizMass_m2, na.rm = TRUE),
    TotalRhizMass_m2 = mean(TotalRhizMass_m2, na.rm = TRUE),
    RootRhizMass_m2 = mean(RootRhizMass_m2, na.rm = TRUE),
    TotalBelowMass_m2 = mean(TotalBelowMass_m2, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
# Create TOTALroot dataset, dropping specific columns
TOTALroot <- root_means %>%
  select(-RootMass_m2, -C3RhizMass_m2, -C4RhizMass_m2, -RhizMass_m2, -TotalRhizMass_m2, -RootRhizMass_m2) %>%
  mutate(TotalBelowMass_m2 = ifelse(is.na(TotalBelowMass_m2), -99, TotalBelowMass_m2))

#Read in data set from previous years
past_years <- read.csv(paste0('S:/Biogeochemistry/GCREW/1-CO2xCommunity Experiment/0-Curated Data/1-Biomass (Derived)/3-CO2xComm Total Root Biomass 1987-',previous_year,'.csv'), header = TRUE, sep = ",")

#Append present year data to previous years
TOTALroot_allyears <- rbind(past_years, TOTALroot)

# Export TOTALroot dataset
write.csv(TOTALroot_allyears, paste0( 'S:/Biogeochemistry/GCREW/1-CO2xCommunity Experiment/0-Curated Data/1-Biomass (Derived)/3-CO2xComm Total Root Biomass 1987-',year,'.csv'), row.names=FALSE)

# Filter ROOTdata for Years >= 2000 and drop specific columns
ROOTBIOtype <- root_means %>%
  filter(Year >= 2000) %>%
  select(-TotalRhizMass_m2, -RootRhizMass_m2)

#Read in data set from previous years
past_years_ROOTBIOtype <- read.csv(paste0('S:/Biogeochemistry/GCREW/1-CO2xCommunity Experiment/0-Curated Data/1-Biomass (Derived)/3-CO2xComm Root Biomass by Category 2000-',previous_year,'.csv'), header = TRUE, sep = ",")

#Append present year data to previous years
ROOTBIOtype_allyears <- rbind(past_years_ROOTBIOtype, ROOTBIOtype)

# Export ROOTBIOtype dataset
write.csv(ROOTBIOtype_allyears, paste0('S:/Biogeochemistry/GCREW/1-CO2xCommunity Experiment/0-Curated Data/1-Biomass (Derived)/3-CO2xComm Root Biomass by Category 2000-',year,'.csv'))

```
